description:
List the tasks in one estate's probate checklist, in the same order the user sees on their SwiftProbate dashboard. SwiftProbate is probate task-management software that helps executors organize and track the steps of settling an estate; tasks are general guidance, not legal advice. Requires sign-in and an estate_id from list_my_estates.

When to use: the user asks what is on their checklist, what to do next, what is done or outstanding, which tasks relate to an asset, or who a task is assigned to. Also use it to get a task's id before updating it (update_task_status, edit_task, update_task_notes, update_task_deadline, assign_task): search by a few words of its title rather than guessing an id. Before creating a task, search here so you do not duplicate one that already exists.

When not to use: for the estate's overall details and task counts, use get_estate_summary; for one task's full record including notes and linked documents, use get_task_detail; for general probate questions unrelated to this estate, use the reference tools.

What to do next: pass up_next: true when the user asks what to do next or where they are. It ignores the other filters and returns up_next, the dashboard's Up Next list (each with id, title, status, priority, deadline, position, waiting_on), plus a note. Lead with the first task. A task with waiting_on cannot start yet, so name the task it waits on as the step to do first. On some plans this list covers estate administration tasks only.

Filters: status, task_category (estate_admin or asset_specific), asset_id, search (every word must appear in the title or description), limit (default 20, max 50), and include_description (adds each task's description and helpful_links).

Returns: a list of tasks, each with id, title, status, priority, deadline, task_category, asset_id, institution_name, completed_at, user_notes, assigned_to, assigned_to_name (null when unassigned), position (its place in the full list), and waiting_on (the unfinished task it depends on, or null).

An empty list right after complete_onboarding usually means the checklist is still generating; wait a minute and try again.

estate_id.description: The estate to act on. Call list_my_estates first to get this id.

include_description.description: When true, include each task's full description in the response. Use when reviewing tasks for content changes (e.g., jurisdiction review). Default false.

limit.description: Max number of tasks to return (default 20)

search.description: Search term to match against task title or description

up_next.description: When true, ignore the other filters and return the dashboard's Up Next list: the next open tasks in the same order the user sees on their Overview page. Use this whenever the user asks what to do next.

name: get_tasks
